resources.string: Emergency mode like realme UI. Only 6 apps stay usable. Background apps are frozen, big CPU cores are taken offline, GPU is locked low, and AOSP battery saver is forced on.
Tap to grant root in SukiSU, then Allow
No root. Open SukiSU → Superuser → allow Super Power Saving.
Tap an icon to change it. Phone / Messages / Browser are filled automatically.
The phone will go back to Axion. Frozen apps will resume.
Turn on super power saving mode?
Only the 6 apps below will open. Incoming calls still work. Brightness, CPU and background apps will be cut hard.\n\nIf you get stuck: SukiSU → Modules → disable Super Power Saving → reboot.
Tip: add the Super Power Save tile in Quick Settings.
Super power saving mode is on
Super power saving mode is off
Module scripts not found. Flash Axion-SPSM.zip in SukiSU and reboot.
